1.1: Yeka ukuhlala kodwa komuzi owawunabantu abaningi! Usungumfelokazi owawunezizwe eziningi. Owawuyinkosikazi phakathi kwezifunda usungobuswayo.
1.2: Uyakhala nokukhala ebusuku, izinyembezi zawo zisezihlathini zawo; kawunamduduzi phakathi kwazo zonke izithandwa zawo; bonke abangane bawo bawuphathe ngenkohliso, sebe yizitha zawo.
1.3: UJuda uthunjiwe ngenxa yokuhlupheka nobugqila obuningi; uhlala phakathi kwabezizwe, katholi ukuphumula; bonke abamzingelayo bamfica ephakathi kobuhlungu.
1.4: Izindlela zaseSiyoni ziyalila ngokuba kungeziwa emikhosini emisiweyo; onke amasango achithekile, abapristi balo bayabubula; izintombi zalo ziyahlupheka, nalo linomunyu.
1.5: Abamelene nalo sebe yinhloko, izitha zalo zinokuthula, ngokuba uJehova ulihluphile ngenxa yobuningi beziphambeko zalo; izingane zalo ziye ekuthunjweni ebusweni bezitha.
1.6: Bonke ubukhosi bumukile endodakazini yaseSiyoni; izikhulu zalo sezinjengezindluzele ezingafumani idlelo, zihambile zingenamandla ebusweni babaxoshayo.
1.7: IJerusalema liyakhumbula ezinsukwini zokuhlupheka kwalo nezinsizi zalo konke okuhle okwakukhona ezinsukwini zasendulo; lapho abantu balo bewela esandleni sezitha, kungekho olisizayo, abamelene nalo balibona, bahleka ukuchithwa kwalo.
1.8: IJerusalema lalonile kakhulu; ngalokho seliyisinengiso; bonke ababelidumisa sebelidelela ngokuba bebone ubunqunu balo; seliyabubula nalo, libuyela emuva.
1.9: Ukungcola kwalo kwakusemaphethelweni alo, alikhumbulanga ukuphela kwalo; lehlile ngokumangalisayo, alinamduduzi. Bheka, Jehova, ukuhlupheka kwami, ngokuba isitha sizikhulisile.
1.10: Isitha selulile isandla saso phezu kwakho konke okumnandi kwalo, ngokuba sibonile ukuthi abezizwe bangene endlini yalo engcwele, owabayala ukuthi abayikungena ebandleni lakho.
1.11: Bonke abantu balo bayabubula, befuna isinkwa sabo; banika okumnandi kwabo ngokudla ukuba babuyise umphefumulo. Bheka, Jehova, ubhekisise, ngokuba ngiyadelelwa.
1.12: “Akulutho kinina nonke enidlula ngendlela na? Bhekani, nibone ukuba kukhona yini ubuhlungu obunjengobuhlungu bami engehlelwe yibo, uJehova angihluphe ngabo ngosuku lokufutheka kwentukuthelo yakhe.
1.13: “Ephezulu ungithumele umlilo emathanjeni ami, wawahlula; wenekele izinyawo zami inetha, wangibuyisela emuva. Ungenze incithakalo, ngiphele amandla usuku lonke.
1.14: “Iziphambeko zami zaboshwa ngesandla sakhe, zaba yijoka; zalukwa, sezisentanyeni yami; wakhubekisa amandla ami. INkosi inginikele esandleni sabo engingenakumelana nabo.
1.15: “INkosi ilahlile onke amaqhawe ami phakathi kwami; ingibizele umhlangano ukuphahlaza izinsizwa zami; iNkosi inyathele njengasesikhamweni sewayini intombi eyindodakazi yakwaJuda.
1.16: “Ngiyakhala ngalokhu; iso lami, iso lami liyamululeka izinyembezi, ngokuba umduduzi wami obeyakubuyisa umphefumulo wami ukude nami. Abantwana bami bachithekile, ngokuba isitha sahlulile.”
1.17: ISiyoni liyelula izandla zalo, akakho oliduduzayo. UJehova uyalile ngoJakobe ukuba abamzungezayo babe yizitha zakhe. IJerusalema linjengesinengiso phakathi kwabo.
1.18: “UJehova ulungile, ngokuba ngihlubukile izwi lakhe. Ake nizwe, bantu bonke, nibone ubuhlungu bami. Izintombi zami nezinsizwa zami ziye ekuthunjweni.
1.19: “Ngazibiza izithandwa zami, zangikhohlisa. Abapristi bami namalunga ami bafela emzini, besafuna ukudla ukuba babuyise umphefumulo wabo.
1.20: “Bheka, Jehova, ngokuba nginosizi; izibilini zami ziyaxhaphazela. Inhliziyo yami iphendukile phakathi kwami, ngokuba ngihlubukile nokuhlubuka. Endle yinkemba eyaphucayo, ekhaya ngukufa.
1.21: “Bezwile ukuthi ngiyabubula, kepha anginamduduzi. Zonke izitha zami zizwile ukuhlupheka kwami; ziyathokoza ukuthi nguwe okwenzileyo. Ululethile usuku olumemezileyo, kepha ziyakuba njengami.
1.22: “Mabufike bonke ububi bazo ebusweni bakho, wenze kuzo njengokwenza kwakho kimi ngenxa yazo zonke iziphambeko zami, ngokuba ukububula kwami kukhulu, nenhliziyo idangele.”

2.1: Yeka ukwembesa kweNkosi indodakazi yaseSiyoni amafu ngentukuthelo yayo. Uphonsile ubuhle buka-Israyeli emhlabeni busuke ezulwini, angasikhumbulanga isenabelo sezinyawo zayo ngosuku lwentukuthelo yayo.
2.2: INkosi igwinyile onke amakhaya kaJakobe ingahawukelanga. Ngentukuthelo yayo, ibhidlizile izinqaba zendodakazi yakwaJuda, yazidilizela emhlabathini, yangcolisa umbuso nezikhulu zawo.
2.3: Yanquma ngokufutheka kolaka lwayo zonke izimpondo zakwa-Israyeli, yabuyisela emuva isandla sayo sokunene ebusweni bezitha, yashisa uJakobe ngomlilo wamalangabi odla nxazonke.
2.4: Yansala umnsalo wayo njengesitha, yema njengomelene nathi ngesokunene sayo, yabulala konke okwakumnandi emehlweni ethu. Etendeni lendodakazi yaseSiyoni yathulula ukufutheka kwayo njengomlilo.
2.5: INkosi isinjengesitha, imgwinyile u-Israyeli; yagwinya zonke izindlu zakhe zobukhosi, yachitha izinqaba zakhe; yandisile endodakazini yakwaJuda ukukhala nokulila.
2.6: Yachitha idokodo layo njengelensimu, yaqeda indawo yayo yokuhlangana. UJehova wenza ukuba kukhohlakale imikhosi emisiweyo namasabatha eSiyoni, wadelela ngokufutheka kolaka lwakhe inkosi nompristi.
2.7: INkosi yalilahla i-altare layo, yanengwa yindlu yayo engcwele, yanikela izingange zezindlu zayo zamakhosi esandleni sesitha. Ziphakamise izwi endlini kaJehova njengasosukwini lomkhosi omisiweyo.
2.8: UJehova wayecebile ukuchitha ugange lwendodakazi yaseSiyoni; wawelula umucu wokulinganisa, akabuyisanga isandla sakhe ekuchitheni; wenza ukuba kukhale ugange nodonga, kudangale kanyekanye.
2.9: Amasango alo ashona emhlabathini; wachitha, wayaphula imigoqo yalo. Inkosi nezikhulu zalo baphakathi kwezizwe, lapho kungekho khona umthetho. Nabaprofethi balo abatholi mbono kuJehova.
2.10: Amalunga endodakazi yaseSiyoni ahlezi emhlabathini, athule; athele uthuli emakhanda awo, abhince indwangu yamasaka. Izintombi zaseJerusalema zithobisela phansi amakhanda azo.
2.11: Amehlo ami ayaphela izinyembezi, izibilini zami ziyaxhaphazela; isibindi sami sithululelwe emhlabathini ngenxa yokuchitheka kwendodakazi yabantu bami, ngokuba izingane nabancelayo bayadangala ezigcawini zomuzi.
2.12: Bathi konina: “Aphi amabele newayini?” lapho bedangala njengababulawayo ezigcawini zomuzi, imiphefumulo yabo ithululelwe ezifubeni zawonina.
2.13: Ngingafakaza ngokuthini ngawe, ngikufanise nani, ndodakazi yaseSiyoni, na? Ngingakulinganisa nani ukuba ngikududuze, ntombi eyindodakazi yaseSiyoni na? Ngokuba ukuchitheka kwakho kukhulu njengolwandle. Ngubani ongakuphulukisa na?
2.14: Abaprofethi bakho bakubonele imibono eyize nobuwula; abambulanga ukona kwakho ukuba babuyise ukuthunjwa kwakho. Kepha bakubonele iziprofetho eziyize nezikhohlisayo.
2.15: Bonke abadlula ngendlela bakushayela ihlombe, bancimfe, banikine amakhanda abo ngenxa yendodakazi yaseJerusalema ngokuthi: “Yiwo lo muzi owawubizwa ngokuthi ubuhle obupheleleyo nentokozo yomhlaba wonke na?”
2.16: Zonke izitha zikukhamisela umlomo wazo, zincimfa, zigedla amazinyo, zithi: “Siwugwinyile. Impela yilo usuku esilulindele; sesilufumene, silubonile.”
2.17: UJehova wenzile lokhu abekucebile; uligcwalisile izwi lakhe, ayeyale ngalo ezinsukwini zasendulo; ubhidlizile engenasihawu, wenza ukuba isitha sithokoze phezu kwakho, waphakamisa uphondo lwabamelene nawe.
2.18: Izinhliziyo zabo zikhala eNkosini; wena lugange lwendodakazi yaseSiyoni, izinyembezi mazehle njengemifula imini nobusuku. Mawungazivumeli ukuphumula, inhlamvu yeso lakho ingayeki.
2.19: Vuka ukhale ebusuku ekuqaleni kwemilindo, uthulule inhliziyo yakho njengamanzi phambi kobuso beNkosi; phakamisa izandla zakho kuyo ngenxa yokuphila kwezingane ezidangala ngendlala ezingosini zezitaladi zonke.
2.20: “Bheka, Jehova, ubone ukuthi wenzile kanjalo kubani. Abesifazane bayakudla yini izithelo zabo, izingane eziphathiweyo kahle, na? Abaprofethi nabapristi bayakubulawa endlini engcwele yeNkosi, na?
2.21: “Balele phansi ezitaladini, abasha nabadala. Izintombi zami nezinsizwa zami ziwile ngenkemba. Wababulala ngosuku lwentukuthelo yakho, wabulala ungahawukelanga.
2.22: “Wabiza njengasosukwini lomhlangano izesabiso zami nxazonke; akubangakho ngosuku lwentukuthelo kaJehova owasindayo nowasalayo. Labo engangibaphathile, ngabondla, izitha zami zibaqedile.”

3.1: Ngingumuntu obone ukuhlupheka ngentonga yentukuthelo yakhe.
3.3: Impela uyangiphendulela isandla sakhe ephinda njalo zonke izinsuku.
3.4: Ugugisile inyama yami nesikhumba sami, waphula amathambo ami.
3.7: Ungibiyele ukuze ngingaphumi, wenza amaketanga ami ukuba asinde.
3.8: Nalapho ngikhala ngicela ukusindiswa, uyavalela umkhuleko wami.
3.9: Ubiyele izindlela zami ngamatshe abaziweyo, wagwegwisa imikhondo yami.
3.10: Ukimi njengebhere* eliqamekelayo nengonyama ezindaweni ezisithekileyo.
3.11: Wachezukisa izindlela zami, wangidwengula, wangenza incithakalo.
3.12: Wansala umnsalo wakhe, wangimisa ngibe yisigcibisholo somcibisholo.
3.13: Wahlaba izinso zami ngemicibisholo yesambo sakhe.
3.14: Sengingohlekwayo kubantu bonke, ngihaywa usuku lonke.
3.16: Waphula amazinyo ami ngohlalwane, wangembesa umlotha.
3.17: Walahla kude nokuthula umphefumulo wami, ngakhohlwa inhlanhla.
3.18: Ngathi: “Amandla ami nethemba lami kuJehova kuphelile.”
3.19: Khumbula ukuhlupheka kwami nosizi lwami, umhlonyane nenyongo.
3.20: Umphefumulo wami uyakukhumbula nokukukhumbula, uthobile phakathi kwami.
3.21: Kepha yilokhu engiyakukubuyisela enhliziyweni yami, ngalokho nginethemba:
3.22: ngumusa kaJehova ukuthi asiqediwe, ngokuba ububele bakhe abupheli.
3.23: Busha ekuseni njalo; ukuthembeka kwakho kukhulu.
3.24: UJehova uyisabelo sami, usho umphefumulo wami; ngakho ngiyakwethemba kuye.
3.26: Kuhle ukumethemba nokulindela ngokuthula ukusindisa kukaJehova.
3.27: Kuhle kumuntu ukuba athwale ijoka ebusheni bakhe.
3.28: Makahlale yedwa, athule, lapho emthwesa lona.
3.29: Makabeke umlomo wakhe othulini; mhlawumbe kungaba khona ithemba.
3.30: Makanike isihlathi sakhe komshayayo, asuthe ngenhlamba.
3.31: Ngokuba uJehova akayikulahla kuze kube phakade.
3.32: Ngokuba noma edabukisile, uyakuhawukela nokho ngokobukhulu bomusa wakhe.
3.33: Ngokuba akahluphi, angadabukisi abantwana babantu ngenxa yokuba ekuthanda.
3.34: Ukuphahlaza phansi kwezinyawo zonke iziboshwa zasemhlabeni,
3.35: nokuchezukisa imfanelo yomuntu phambi kobuso boPhezukonke,
3.36: nokona umuntu ecaleni lakhe, iNkosi ayikuboni lokhu na?
3.37: Kwasho ubani, kwenzakala, iNkosi ingakuyalelanga, na?
3.38: Akuphumi okuhle nokubi emlonyeni woPhezukonke na?
3.39: Ukhononelani umuntu ophilayo, umuntu ojeziswa ngezono zakhe, na?
3.40: Masiphenye, sicinge izindlela zethu, sibuyele kuJehova.
3.41: Masiphakamise izinhliziyo zethu kanye nezandla zethu kuNkulunkulu ezulwini.
3.44: Wazembesa ifu, ukuze imikhuleko yethu ingafinyeleli.
3.46: Zonke izitha zethu zisikhamisele imilomo yazo.
3.48: Iso lami liyamululeka imifula yamanzi ngenxa yokuchithwa kwendodakazi yabantu bami.
3.49: Iso lami liyamululeka, alinqamuki; akukho ukukhawuka,
3.51: Iso lami lenza umphefumulo wami ube buhlungu ngenxa yawo onke amadodakazi omuzi wakithi.
3.52: Abayizitha zami ngeze bangizingele nokungizingela njengenyoni.
3.53: Banqume ukuphila kwami emgodini, bangiphonsa ngetshe.
3.55: Ngalibiza igama lakho, Jehova, ngisemgodini phansi.
3.56: Wezwa izwi lami; ungasithezi indlebe yakho lapho ngikhalela ukusizwa.
3.58: Nkosi, umela indaba yomphefumulo wami, uyahlenga ukuphila kwami.
3.59: Jehova, uyabona ukoniwa kwami; thetha indaba yami.
3.60: Uyabona konke ukuphindisa kwabo nawo onke amacebo abo ngami.
3.61: Uyezwa inhlamba yabo, Jehova, nawo onke amacebo abo ngami,
3.62: izindebe zabangivukeleyo nemicabango yabo ngami izinsuku zonke.
3.63: Bheka ukuhlala kwabo nokuvuka kwabo; ngihaywa yibo.
3.65: Uyakubanika isimbozo senhliziyo, isiqalekiso sakho sibe phezu kwabo.
3.66: Uyakubaxosha ngentukuthelo, ubabhubhise, bangabe besaba khona phansi kwezulu likaJehova.

4.1: Yeka ukufiphala kwegolide nokuguquka kwegolide elihle! Amatshe endlu engcwele ahlakazekile ezingosini zazo zonke izitaladi.
4.2: Amadodana anqabileyo aseSiyoni, elingene negolide elihle, yeka ukuthiwa kwawo ayizitsha zebumba, imisebenzi yezandla zombumbi!
4.3: Namakhanka ehlisa, ancelise amazinyane awo. Indodakazi yabantu bami isinonya, njengezintshe zasehlane.
4.4: Ulimi loncelayo lunamathela olwangeni lwakhe ngokoma. Izingane zicela isinkwa, kepha akakho ozihlephulelayo.
4.5: Abakade bedla okumnandi sebechithakele ezitaladini. Ababekhuliswa ngokububende sebesingatha izala.
4.6: Ukona kwendodakazi yabantu bami kukhulu kunesono saseSodoma elachithwa ngokuphazima kweso, kungasondelanga zandla kulo.
4.7: Abakhulu balo babehlambulukile kunongqoqwane, babe mhlophe kunobisi; imizimba yabo yayibomvana kunekorali,* isimo sabo sasinjengesafire.*
4.8: Ubuso babo sebumnyama kunelahle, abaziwa ezitaladini. Isikhumba sabo sinamathela emathanjeni abo, sishwabene, saba njengomuthi.
4.9: Babe ngcono ababebulawa ngenkemba kunababebulawa ngendlala, ababuna behlatshiwe ngokuswela ukudla kwensimu.
4.10: Izandla zabesifazane abahawukelayo zapheka izingane zabo; zazingukudla kwabo ngokuchithwa kwendodakazi yabantu bami.
4.11: UJehova ufezile ukufutheka kwakhe, uthululile ukufutheka kwentukuthelo yakhe; uphembile umlilo eSiyoni oqedile izisekelo zalo.
4.12: Amakhosi omhlaba ayengakholwa kanye nabo bonke abakhileyo ezweni ukuthi abamelene nabo nezitha zabo babeyakungena emasangweni aseJerusalema.
4.13: Kungenxa yezono zabaprofethi balo nobubi babapristi balo ababechitha igazi labalungileyo phakathi kwalo.
4.14: Bazulazula njengezimpumputhe ezitaladini, bengcolile ngegazi ngangokuba zazingenakuthintwa izingubo zabo.
4.15: “Chezukani, ningcolile!” bamemeza kubo: “Chezukani, chezukani, ningathinti!” Lapho bebaleka bezulazula, bathi phakathi kwabezizwe: “Abasayikugogobala lapha.”
4.16: Ubuso bukaJehova buyabahlakaza, akasayikubanakekela. Abahloniphi ubuso babapristi, kababanga namusa kumalunga.
4.17: Amehlo ethu ayaphela ukubheka usizo lwethu oluyize; ekulindeni kwethu silindela isizwe esingenakusindisa.
4.18: Bazingela izinyathelo zethu ukuba singahambi ezigcawini zethu. Ukugcina kwethu kuseduze, izinsuku zethu zigcwele, yebo, ukugcina kwethu kufikile.
4.19: Abasixoshayo babenejubane kunezinkozi zezulu; basizingela ezintabeni, basiqamekela ehlane.
4.20: Umoya wamakhala ethu, ogcotshiweyo kaJehova, wabanjwa emigodini yabo, esathi ngaye: “Phansi kwethunzi lakhe siyakuphila phakathi kwezizwe.”
4.21: Jabula, uthokoze, ndodakazi yakwa-Edomi, ohlala ezweni lase-Uzi. Indebe iyakudlulela nakuwena; uyakudakwa, uzenze nqunu.
4.22: Ububi bakho sebuphelile, ndodakazi yaseSiyoni, kasayikukuthumba. Ububi bakho, ndodakazi yakwa-Edomi, uyakubuhambela, azambule izono zakho.

5.1: Khumbula, Jehova, esehlelwe yikho; bheka, ubone ihlazo lethu.
5.2: Ifa lethu seliphendulelwe abafokazi, nezindlu zethu kwabezizwe.
5.4: Amanzi ethu siyawaphuza ngemali, izinkuni zethu ziza ngentengo.
5.6: Sinike isandla sethu kulo iGibithe nakulo i-Asiriya ukuba sisuthe isinkwa.
5.7: Obaba bona abasekho; thina sithwala ububi babo.
5.8: Izigqila ziyasibusa; akakho osikhulula esandleni sabo.
5.9: Sithola ukudla kwethu ngokuzidela amathambo ngenxa yenkemba yasehlane.
5.10: Isikhumba sethu siyasha njengeziko ngokushisa kwendlala.
5.11: Balala nabesifazane eSiyoni, izintombi zasemizini yakwaJuda.
5.12: Izikhulu zaphanyekwa ngezandla zabo; ubuso babadala ababuhloniphanga.
5.13: Izinsizwa zathwala amatshe okugaya, abantwana bakhubeka phansi kwezinkuni.
5.14: Abadala baphelile esangweni, nezinsizwa ekuhlabeleleni kwazo.
5.15: Intokozo yenhliziyo yethu iphelile; ukusina kwethu kuphenduke ukulila.
5.16: Umqhele uwile ekhanda lethu. Maye kithina, ngokuba sonile!
5.17: Ngalokho inhliziyo yethu idangele; ngalezi zinto amehlo ethu afiphele,
5.18: ngenxa yentaba yaseSiyoni echithekile, zize zihambe kuyo izimpungushe.
5.19: Wena Jehova umi phakade; isihlalo sakho sobukhosi sikhona ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
5.20: Usikhohlelwani kuze kube phakade, usishiye izinsuku eziningi, na?
5.21: Sibuyisele kuwe Jehova, siyakubuya; yenza izinsuku zethu zibe zintsha njengasendulo,
